units.title: Concrete threshold versus actual Gaussian bias
units.reader_note: The actual quarter-bias conclusion comes first; its complete parameter and C-scope qualifications, formula proof and exact Lean are folded beside it.
units.statement: The concrete threshold eventually lies below one quarter of the actual target Gaussian bias.
assumptions: Fix a positive real numerical scale \(C\), then \(0<\delta<1\). There is one natural cutoff \(d_0(C,\delta)\), chosen before all varying \(d,\kappa,q\). The cutoff is not asserted uniform over unbounded \(C\).

For every natural \(d\ge d_0(C,\delta)\), real \(2\le\kappa\le d^{1-\delta}\), and natural \(q\ge0\) with \(q\le(\delta/256)\sqrt\kappa\log d\), put \(n=2q+1\). The exact integer query-cap regime includes \(q=0\); it is not an expected-cost statement.

Use \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(\lambda_i=(\kappa+1)/2+(\kappa-1)\cos\theta_i/2\), \(\Lambda=\operatorname{diag}(\lambda_i)\), \(U\sim N(0,\Lambda^{-1})\), and \(Q(x)=\sum_i\cos(n\theta_i)x_i^2\). Set \(M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2\), \(b=\mathbb E Q(U)\), and \(\beta=|b|/M\). Lean uses the same grid with zero-based finite coordinates.

The threshold is literal: \(\tau_{d,q}=C[(q+1)\sqrt{\log d/d}+(q+1)(q+1+\log d)\log d/d]\). All dimension, frequency, inverse-covariance, integrability, positivity and uniform-smallness conditions are established internally.

This is a numerical auxiliary family for each fixed positive \(C\). The separate concentration argument must still produce one sufficiently large absolute \(C\), fixed before \(\delta\); specializing the family to that value then yields a \(\delta\)-only cutoff. No \(C\)-premise is added to either main lower bound.

notation.text: The exact threshold with fixed positive numeric coefficient; no asymptotic proxy is substituted.
Actual same-law norm/cosine means and normalized bias; B is a separate fixed positive number.
notation.formula: M=\mathbb E\|U\|^2,\quad b=\mathbb E Q(U),\quad\beta=|b|/M,\quad B=(1-e^{-4})e^{-3}.

steps.title: Bound both terms of the literal threshold
steps.text: For log d≥1 write R=d^((1−δ)/2). The original condition/query caps give sqrt κ≤R and q+1≤2R log d, including q=0. Since R≥1, q+1+log d≤3R log d; also sqrt(log d/d)≤log d/sqrt d. Bound the two nonnegative terms separately, using R/sqrt d=d^(−δ/2) and R²/d=d^(−δ).
steps.detail: The full private threshold_envelope provider is shown. Its local positive-base/log/range guards are discharged inside the eventual provider. The coefficient8 is an explicit sufficient realization of the source implicit comparison, not a concentration constant.
steps.lean:
private theorem threshold_envelope {C δ κ : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (d q : ℕ)
    (hd : 1 ≤ (d : ℝ)) (hlog : 1 ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ))
    (hκcap : κ ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - δ))
    (hq : (q : ℝ) ≤ (δ / 256) * Real.sqrt κ * Real.log (d : ℝ)) :
    C * (((q : ℝ) + 1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
      (((q : ℝ) + 1) * ((q : ℝ) + 1 + Real.log (d : ℝ)) * Real.log (d : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ))
      ≤ 8 * C * (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 2) * (Real.log (d : ℝ)) ^ 3 := by
  let x : ℝ := d
  let L : ℝ := Real.log x
  let R : ℝ := x ^ ((1 - δ) / 2)
  let A : ℝ := (q : ℝ) + 1
  change C * (A * Real.sqrt (L / x) + A * (A + L) * L / x) ≤
    8 * C * x ^ (-δ / 2) * L ^ 3
  have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := hd
  have hx : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hL1 : 1 ≤ L := hlog
  have hL0 : 0 ≤ L := by linarith
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := Real.rpow_nonneg hx.le _
  have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := by
    dsimp [R]
    exact Real.one_le_rpow hx1 (by linarith)
  have hs : Real.sqrt κ ≤ R := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ (1 - δ)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hκcap
      _ = R := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_mul hx.le]
        congr 1
        ring
  have hqR : (q : ℝ) ≤ R * L := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (δ / 256) * Real.sqrt κ * L := hq
      _ ≤ 1 * R * L := by gcongr; linarith
      _ = R * L := by ring
  have hRL : 1 ≤ R * L := by
    calc
      1 ≤ 1 * L := by linarith
      _ ≤ R * L := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hR1 hL0
  have hA : A ≤ 2 * R * L := by dsimp [A]; linarith
  have hsum : A + L ≤ 3 * R * L := by
    have hLR : L ≤ R * L := by nlinarith
    linarith
  have hsL : Real.sqrt L ≤ L := (Real.sqrt_le_iff).2 ⟨hL0, by nlinarith⟩
  have hsdiv : Real.sqrt (L / x) ≤ L / Real.sqrt x := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_div hL0]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsL (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hRdiv : R / Real.sqrt x = x ^ (-δ / 2) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, ← Real.rpow_sub hx]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hR2div : R ^ 2 / x = x ^ (-δ) := by
    have he : R ^ 2 = x ^ (((1 - δ) / 2) * 2) := by
      dsimp [R]
      rw [Real.rpow_mul hx.le]
      norm_num
    rw [he, ← Real.rpow_sub_one (ne_of_gt hx)]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hLpow : L ^ 2 ≤ L ^ 3 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ L ^ 2 * L := le_mul_of_one_le_right (sq_nonneg L) hL1
      _ = L ^ 3 := by ring
  have hfirst : A * Real.sqrt (L / x) ≤ 2 * x ^ (-δ / 2) * L ^ 3 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 * R * L) * (L / Real.sqrt x) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 * (R / Real.sqrt x) * L ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 2 * x ^ (-δ / 2) * L ^ 2 := by rw [hRdiv]
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hLpow (by positivity)
  have hsecond : A * (A + L) * L / x ≤ 6 * x ^ (-δ / 2) * L ^ 3 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2 * R * L) * (3 * R * L) * L / x := by gcongr
      _ = 6 * (R ^ 2 / x) * L ^ 3 := by ring
      _ = 6 * x ^ (-δ) * L ^ 3 := by rw [hR2div]
      _ ≤ _ := by
        have hp : x ^ (-δ) ≤ x ^ (-δ / 2) :=
          Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hx1 (by linarith)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by norm_num))
          (pow_nonneg hL0 3)
  calc
    _ ≤ C * (2 * x ^ (-δ / 2) * L ^ 3 + 6 * x ^ (-δ / 2) * L ^ 3) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add hfirst hsecond) hC
    _ = _ := by ring

steps.title: Choose a single numerical cutoff before the varying parameters
steps.text: Put B=(1−exp(−4))exp(−3)>0. The canonical logarithmic asymptotic gives (log d)^3=o(d^(δ/4)). Apply it with the positive numerical coefficient B/(32C), simultaneously require log d≥1 and d≥1, and extract one natural cutoff. Multiplying by the previous envelope yields the concrete polynomial bound.
steps.detail: The complete eventual_threshold_power_small provider produces its cutoff internally and uniformly over κ and q. The existence witness is an output. Real powers and natural powers of the logarithm are converted explicitly; no caller supplies an eventual estimate.
steps.lean:
private theorem eventual_threshold_power_small (C B : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hB : 0 < B)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ0 : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) :
  ∃ D : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, D ≤ d → ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ →
    κ ≤ (d : ℝ) ^ (1 - δ) → ∀ q : ℕ,
    (q : ℝ) ≤ (δ / 256) * Real.sqrt κ * Real.log (d : ℝ) →
    let τ : ℝ := C * (((q : ℝ) + 1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
      (((q : ℝ) + 1) * ((q : ℝ) + 1 + Real.log (d : ℝ)) * Real.log (d : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ))
    0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ (B / 4) * (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 4) := by
  have hlo : (fun d : ℕ => Real.log (d : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℕ)) =o[atTop]
      (fun d : ℕ => (d : ℝ) ^ (δ / 4)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.rpow_ofNat] using
      (isLittleO_log_rpow_rpow_atTop (3 : ℝ) (by linarith : 0 < δ / 4)).comp_tendsto
        tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have heps : 0 < B / (32 * C) := by positivity
  have hlogevent : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop, 1 ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ) :=
    (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually
      (eventually_ge_atTop 1)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ d : ℕ in atTop,
      1 ≤ d ∧ 1 ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (d : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℕ) ≤ (B / (32 * C)) * (d : ℝ) ^ (δ / 4) := by
    filter_upwards [hlo.def heps, hlogevent, eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℕ)] with d hd hl hd1
    have hl0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ) := by linarith
    refine ⟨hd1, hl, ?_⟩
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg hl0 3),
      abs_of_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg d) _)] using hd
  rcases eventually_atTop.1 hev with ⟨D, hD⟩
  refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
  intro d hd κ hκ hκcap q hq
  rcases hD d hd with ⟨hd1, hlog, hsmall⟩
  have hd1real : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hd1
  have hdpos : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ) := by linarith
  constructor
  · positivity
  · have he := threshold_envelope hC.le hδ0.le hδ1.le d q hd1real hlog
      hκcap hq
    have hp : (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 2) * (d : ℝ) ^ (δ / 4) =
        (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 4) := by
      rw [← Real.rpow_add hdpos]
      congr 1
      ring
    have hc : 8 * C * (B / (32 * C)) = B / 4 := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hC]; ring
    calc
      _ ≤ 8 * C * (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 2) * Real.log (d : ℝ) ^ 3 := he
      _ ≤ 8 * C * (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 2) *
          ((B / (32 * C)) * (d : ℝ) ^ (δ / 4)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall (by positivity)
      _ = (8 * C * (B / (32 * C))) *
          ((d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 2) * (d : ℝ) ^ (δ / 4)) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hc, hp]

steps.title: Establish the actual Gaussian and valid frequency
steps.text: Take the maximum of the numerical cutoff and canonical ModeGap cutoff. ModeGap supplies d≥2, 1≤n<d and d−n≥sqrt κ. Apply canonical Bias to the same literal inverse-precision Gaussian and actual integral ratio. It supplies positive M, positive signed cosine mean, and both exponential bias estimates.
steps.detail: The range conditions are passed at the exact local means/bias use. The signature has no free Gaussian law, covariance, integrability, moment, sign or gap certificate. All such facts come from the existing canonical producers.
steps.lean:
let B : ℝ := (1 - Real.exp (-4)) * Real.exp (-3)
  have he4 : Real.exp (-4) < 1 := by
    simpa only [Real.exp_zero] using Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr (by norm_num : (-4 : ℝ) < 0)
  have hBpos : 0 < B := mul_pos (by linarith) (Real.exp_pos _)
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := eventual_threshold_power_small C B hC hBpos hδ0 hδ1
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := eventual_source_query_mode_gap hδ0 hδ1
  refine ⟨max D K, ?_⟩
  intro d hd κ hκ hκcap q hq
  have hdD : D ≤ d := (le_max_left D K).trans hd
  have hdK : K ≤ d := (le_max_right D K).trans hd
  let n : ℕ := 2 * q + 1
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let Λ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal eigenvalue
  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) := multivariateGaussian 0 Λ⁻¹
  let Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x =>
    ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp x i) ^ 2
  let τ : ℝ := C * (((q : ℝ) + 1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
      (((q : ℝ) + 1) * ((q : ℝ) + 1 + Real.log (d : ℝ)) * Real.log (d : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ))
  let M : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
  let b : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Q x ∂μ
  let β : ℝ := |b| / M
  change 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ τ ≤ β / 4
  have hadm := hK d hdK κ hκ hκcap q hq
  change 2 ≤ d ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ n < d ∧ Real.sqrt κ ≤ (d : ℝ) - (n : ℝ) at hadm
  rcases hadm with ⟨hd2, hn1, hnd, hgap⟩
  have ht := hD d hdD κ hκ hκcap q hq
  change 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ (B / 4) * (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 4) at ht
  rcases ht with ⟨hτ0, hτpoly⟩
  rcases actual_diagonal_gaussian_exponential_bias hd2 hκ n hn1 hnd hgap with
    ⟨_hMpos, _hsign, hlow, hupp⟩
  change (1 - Real.exp (-4)) * Real.exp (-3 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) ≤ β at hlow
  change β ≤ Real.exp (-2 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) at hupp

steps.title: Compare the actual bias with the source power scale
steps.text: Divide the original q cap by the positive sqrt κ. Since n=2q+1 and sqrt κ≥1, obtain 3n/sqrt κ≤3+(3δ/128)log d≤3+(δ/4)log d. Monotonicity of exp and positive-base real powers turn the canonical actual bias lower bound into the required polynomial lower bound.
steps.detail: This is inline numerical bookkeeping applied to canonical Bias, not a claimed call to a prior private Test or a new duplicated public bias theorem. The unchanged compiled canonical Bias node is shared with the earlier signal-strength proof.
steps.lean:
have hdpos : 0 < (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < d)
  have hd1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ d)
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (d : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hd1
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt κ := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
  have hsone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt κ := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by nlinarith)
  have hqr : (q : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ ≤ (δ / 256) * Real.log (d : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hspos).2
    calc
      _ ≤ (δ / 256) * Real.sqrt κ * Real.log (d : ℝ) := hq
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h3s : 3 / Real.sqrt κ ≤ (3 : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hspos).2
    nlinarith
  have hncalc : 3 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ =
      6 * ((q : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) + 3 / Real.sqrt κ := by
    simp only [n, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    ring
  have hns : 3 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ ≤ 3 + (δ / 4) * Real.log (d : ℝ) := by
    have hrelax : (3 * δ / 128) * Real.log (d : ℝ) ≤
        (δ / 4) * Real.log (d : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith : 3 * δ / 128 ≤ δ / 4) hlog0
    rw [hncalc]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 6)]
  have hexponent : -3 + Real.log (d : ℝ) * (-δ / 4) ≤
      -3 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ := by
    calc
      _ = -(3 + (δ / 4) * Real.log (d : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ -(3 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) := neg_le_neg hns
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hpoly : B * (d : ℝ) ^ (-δ / 4) ≤ β := by
    calc
      _ = (1 - Real.exp (-4)) *
          (Real.exp (-3) * Real.exp (Real.log (d : ℝ) * (-δ / 4))) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hdpos]
        dsimp [B]
        ring
      _ = (1 - Real.exp (-4)) * Real.exp (-3 + Real.log (d : ℝ) * (-δ / 4)) := by
        rw [Real.exp_add]
      _ ≤ (1 - Real.exp (-4)) * Real.exp (-3 * (n : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hexponent) (by linarith)
      _ ≤ β := hlow

steps.title: Return the actual quarter-bias and half-threshold bounds
steps.text: The numerical upper bound is at most beta/4 by the actual bias lower bound. The canonical upper bias estimate gives beta≤1, so the stronger quarter-bias bound also implies tau≤1/2. Nonnegativity was already established for the literal formula.
steps.detail: This local half-threshold proof is a sufficient route using actual target bias, distinct from the source earlier scalar-only half cutoff used before the algorithmic bound. The independently reconstructed source order stays unchanged. No tau/beta Tendsto declaration, source-valid concentration C or full Ex24/Ex26 is emitted.

steps.title: Apply the threshold to a genuine shifted Gaussian event
steps.text: Enlarge one C,delta cutoff so canonical SignalStrength gives M beta²≥320. Under the actual diagonal law let X=(−1)^n Q(U) and Z=X−2tau‖U‖². Their actual means give EZ≥beta M/2>0. Both canonical quadratic L2/variance bounds are used. Integrating the centered pointwise Young inequality gives Var Z≤2 Var X+8tau² Var(‖U‖²)≤8M. Chebyshev then bounds the actual non-strict bad event by1/10, with finite mass established before toReal.
steps.detail: The full private Test is shown. This centered Young route is a sufficient variant of the source L2 triangle argument; it assumes no independence between the two forms and does not call/copy the earlier private contrast provider. The threshold, signal, actual moments, positivity and finite-measure conversion are all internally produced. Orthogonal law transport, the rotated polynomial detector, concentration and algorithms remain separate.

  let n : ℕ := 2 * q + 1
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)

  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) := multivariateGaussian 0 Λ⁻¹
  let Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x =>
    ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp x i) ^ 2
  let τ : ℝ := C * (((q : ℝ) + 1) * Real.sqrt (Real.log (d : ℝ) / (d : ℝ)) +
      (((q : ℝ) + 1) * ((q : ℝ) + 1 + Real.log (d : ℝ)) * Real.log (d : ℝ)) / (d : ℝ))
  let N : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x => ‖x‖ ^ 2
  let M : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
  let b : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), Q x ∂μ
  let β : ℝ := |b| / M
  let X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * Q x
  let Z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x => X x - 2 * τ * N x
  let m : ℝ := (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b
  let zmean : ℝ := m - 2 * τ * M
  change (μ {x | Z x ≤ 0}).toReal ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 10
  have hadm := hK d hdK κ hκ hκcap q hq
  change 2 ≤ d ∧ 1 ≤ n ∧ n < d ∧ Real.sqrt κ ≤ (d : ℝ) - (n : ℝ) at hadm
  rcases hadm with ⟨hd2, hn1, hnd, hgap⟩
  have ht := hT d hdT κ hκ hκcap q hq
  change 0 ≤ τ ∧ τ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ τ ≤ β / 4 at ht
  rcases ht with ⟨hτ0, hτhalf, hτβ⟩
  have hs := hS d hdS κ hκ hκcap q hq
  change 0 < M ∧ 0 < β ∧ (d : ℝ) / (2 * Real.sqrt κ) ≤ M ∧
    (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 + δ) / 2) / 2 ≤ M ∧
    (B ^ 2 / 2) * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) ≤ M * β ^ 2 at hs
  rcases hs with ⟨hMpos, hβpos, _hMlower, _hMpower, hproduct⟩
  have hJsq : (J : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (d : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdJ
  have hJsqrt : (J : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) := Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hJsq
  have hthreshold : (320 : ℝ) ≤ (B ^ 2 / 2) * Real.sqrt (d : ℝ) := by
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hJ.trans hJsqrt) (by positivity : 0 ≤ B ^ 2 / 2)
    have heq : (B ^ 2 / 2) * (640 / B ^ 2) = (320 : ℝ) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hBpos]; ring
    rw [heq] at ht
    exact ht
  have hsignal : (320 : ℝ) ≤ M * β ^ 2 := hthreshold.trans hproduct
  rcases actual_diagonal_gaussian_exponential_bias hd2 hκ n hn1 hnd hgap with
    ⟨_hMposBias, hmpos, _hlow, _hupp⟩
  change 0 < m at hmpos
  rcases actual_diagonal_gaussian_quadratic_variances hd2 hκ n hn1 hnd with
    ⟨hN, hQ, _hNexact, _hQexact, hNbound, hQbound, _hMupper⟩
  change MemLp N 2 μ at hN
  change MemLp Q 2 μ at hQ
  change Var[N; μ] ≤ 2 * M at hNbound
  change Var[Q; μ] ≤ 2 * M at hQbound
  have hX : MemLp X 2 μ := hQ.const_mul _
  have hZ : MemLp Z 2 μ := hX.sub (hN.const_mul (2 * τ))
  have hmeanX : (∫ x, X x ∂μ) = m := by exact integral_const_mul _ _
  have hmeanZ : (∫ x, Z x ∂μ) = zmean := by
    calc
      _ = (∫ x, X x ∂μ) - ∫ x, (2 * τ) * N x ∂μ :=
        integral_sub (hX.integrable (by norm_num))
          ((hN.const_mul (2 * τ)).integrable (by norm_num))
      _ = _ := by rw [hmeanX, integral_const_mul]
  have habs : |b| = m := by
    calc
      |b| = |(-1 : ℝ) ^ n * b| := by rw [abs_mul, abs_neg_one_pow, one_mul]
      _ = _ := abs_of_pos hmpos
  have hmeanRatio : m = β * M := by
    dsimp [β]
    rw [habs]
    exact (div_mul_cancel₀ m (ne_of_gt hMpos)).symm
  have hmeansq : m ^ 2 = (M * β ^ 2) * M := by rw [hmeanRatio]; ring
  have hmeanlower : m / 2 ≤ zmean := by
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτβ hMpos.le
    dsimp [zmean]
    rw [hmeanRatio]
    nlinarith
  have hzpos : 0 < zmean := by linarith
  have hsign : ((-1 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hXbound : Var[X; μ] ≤ 2 * M := by
    change Var[fun x => (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * Q x; μ] ≤ _
    rw [variance_const_mul, hsign, one_mul]
    exact hQbound
  have hcenter (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :
      Z x - (∫ y, Z y ∂μ) =
        (X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) - 2 * τ * (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)) := by
    rw [hmeanZ, hmeanX]
    change (X x - 2 * τ * N x) - (m - 2 * τ * M) =
      (X x - m) - 2 * τ * (N x - M)
    ring
  have hIZ := (hZ.sub (memLp_const (∫ x, Z x ∂μ))).integrable_sq
  have hI1 := ((hX.sub (memLp_const (∫ x, X x ∂μ))).integrable_sq).const_mul (2 : ℝ)
  have hI2 := ((hN.sub (memLp_const (∫ x, N x ∂μ))).integrable_sq).const_mul (8 * τ ^ 2)
  change Integrable (fun x => (Z x - (∫ y, Z y ∂μ)) ^ 2) μ at hIZ
  change Integrable (fun x => 2 * (X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) ^ 2) μ at hI1
  change Integrable (fun x => (8 * τ ^ 2) * (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)) ^ 2) μ at hI2
  have hVYoung : Var[Z; μ] ≤ 2 * Var[X; μ] + 8 * τ ^ 2 * Var[N; μ] := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ x, (Z x - (∫ y, Z y ∂μ)) ^ 2 ∂μ := variance_eq_integral hZ.aemeasurable
      _ ≤ ∫ x, (2 * (X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) ^ 2 +
          (8 * τ ^ 2) * (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)) ^ 2) ∂μ := by
        apply integral_mono_ae hIZ (hI1.add hI2)
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
          change (Z x - (∫ y, Z y ∂μ)) ^ 2 ≤
            2 * (X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) ^ 2 +
              (8 * τ ^ 2) * (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)) ^ 2
          rw [hcenter x]
          nlinarith only [sq_nonneg ((X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) +
            2 * τ * (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)))]
      _ = 2 * (∫ x, (X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) ^ 2 ∂μ) +
          (8 * τ ^ 2) * (∫ x, (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)) ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
        calc
          _ = (∫ x, 2 * (X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) ^ 2 ∂μ) +
              (∫ x, (8 * τ ^ 2) * (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)) ^ 2 ∂μ) :=
            integral_add hI1 hI2
          _ = _ := congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℝ => a + b)
            (integral_const_mul 2 (fun x => (X x - (∫ y, X y ∂μ)) ^ 2))
            (integral_const_mul (8 * τ ^ 2) (fun x => (N x - (∫ y, N y ∂μ)) ^ 2))
      _ = _ := congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℝ => 2 * a + (8 * τ ^ 2) * b)
        (variance_eq_integral hX.aemeasurable).symm
        (variance_eq_integral hN.aemeasurable).symm
  have hτsq : τ ^ 2 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4 := by nlinarith only [hτ0, hτhalf]
  have hV : Var[Z; μ] ≤ 8 * M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * Var[X; μ] + 8 * τ ^ 2 * Var[N; μ] := hVYoung
      _ ≤ 2 * (2 * M) + 8 * τ ^ 2 * (2 * M) :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXbound (by norm_num))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hNbound (by positivity))
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hτsq hMpos.le]
  have hlarge : 80 * M ≤ zmean ^ 2 := by
    have hsM := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsignal hMpos.le
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0 ≤ m / 2) hmeanlower 2
    rw [← hmeansq] at hsM
    nlinarith only [hsM, hsq]
  have hsub : {x | Z x ≤ 0} ⊆ {x | zmean ≤ |Z x - (∫ y, Z y ∂μ)|} := by
    intro x hx
    change Z x ≤ 0 at hx
    change zmean ≤ |Z x - (∫ y, Z y ∂μ)|
    rw [hmeanZ, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : Z x - zmean ≤ 0)]
    linarith
  have hc := meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq hZ hzpos
  have hm : μ {x | Z x ≤ 0} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Var[Z; μ] / zmean ^ 2) :=
    (measure_mono hsub).trans (by simpa only [hmeanZ] using hc)
  have hprob : (μ {x | Z x ≤ 0}).toReal ≤ Var[Z; μ] / zmean ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (Var[Z; μ] / zmean ^ 2)).toReal :=
        ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hm
      _ = _ := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (variance_nonneg _ _) (sq_nonneg _))
  calc
    _ ≤ Var[Z; μ] / zmean ^ 2 := hprob
    _ ≤ 8 * M / zmean ^ 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hV (sq_nonneg zmean)
    _ ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 10 := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hzpos)).2
      nlinarith
